data.exact_reserve_text: The adverse impacts to the underwriting result were partially offset by a release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m (2016, GBP 57.6m release). The 2017 underwriting loss was also signficantly impacted by a change to the Ogden discount rate. On February 27, 2017 the UK Ministry of Justice announced that the discount rate in the Ogden tables will decrease from 2.5% to minus 0.75%. As a result of this reduction the reserves held on the 2014 and prior years of account relating to UK Motor Treaty business have been adversely impacted, resulting in a GBP 52.4m strengthening to the prior year losses.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a mixed prior year development in 2017, with an overall gross release of GBP 8.1 million. This was driven by a GBP 52.4 million gross strengthening to prior year losses, specifically impacting UK Motor Treaty business from 2014 and prior years of account, due to a change in the Ogden discount rate. This adverse impact was partially offset by favorable claims development from other prior year reserves, which resulted in a net release of GBP 59.2 million.

data.data_quality_notes: The overall gross prior year development of -8.1m was calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This figure represents the combined effect of a GBP 52.4m gross strengthening due to the Ogden rate change and an implied gross release of GBP 60.5m from other prior year reserves (to reconcile with the stated net release of GBP 59.2m and the overall gross movement).
